momentum_note: The Trust Market is accelerating across every sector represented. Verified identity (AmEx premium), verified measurement (Comscore cross-platform +30%), verified diagnostics (Natera oncology +57%), verified content safety (Fox live event +78%), verified government execution (Leidos 87% gov revenue + backlog), verified healthcare infrastructure (Labcorp margin expansion), and verified workplace compliance (Brady +8.2% organic) all show sustained or accelerating pricing power. This is not a subscription story or a volume play. It is a structural shift: when content and information became nearly free and increasingly synthetic after 2022, the scarce input flipped from production to credibility. Every packet in this set shows customers paying premium prices for assurance—whether that is high-income cardholder status, ad-verified audiences, molecularly confirmed diagnosis, brand-safe inventory, cleared government systems, or workplace safety traceability.
